sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and input checks
sections.what: Loads the schema, content builder, edit tool and PowerPoint renderer, then reads the source recipe and checks its shape.
sections.why: Likely reason: an early shape check stops a bad input before any file is written.
sections.watch_out: A recipe that does not match the schema is rejected before anything else happens.

sections.name: edits
sections.title: Rebuilding and exporting the deck
sections.what: Collects the title edits from the original, rebuilds the content, checks the facts are unchanged, then exports the PowerPoint and writes the model, the file copy and the report.
sections.why: Likely reason: rebuilding from the frozen source lets the layout be checked on its own, without changing the content.
sections.watch_out: Any non-title edit makes the script throw, and the content and visual checks are marked not run, so a person must review the output before trusting it.

summary: An offline check that rebuilds a frozen Lessons Learnt recipe into a PowerPoint file and a report, without using the database, network or a model, and never promotes the result.
purpose: It tests that the saved recipe lays out correctly as slides and exports cleanly, so a reviewer can inspect the output.
why: The header calls it an offline layout check, and the report says the output is not accepted or promoted.
how: It reads the source recipe, checks its shape, and rebuilds the full slide content. It reapplies the title edits recorded in the original, confirms the facts did not change, exports the PowerPoint, and writes the model JSON, a copy of the file, and a report with its checks marked as not run.
inputs: Two command line arguments: the path to the source recipe JSON and an output name prefix.
outputs: A model JSON file, a PowerPoint file and a report JSON file named from the prefix, plus one console line with the page counts.
risks: Only title edits are reapplied, and any other kind of edit makes the script stop. The content and visual checks are not run, so the output has not been checked for correctness. It also overwrites files at the output prefix.
debug: A usage error means one of the two arguments is missing. Frozen source facts changed means the rebuild altered the facts, so compare the source. The export warnings are listed in the report.
